operations.title: The cyclic-monodromy Adams spectrum needs no semisimplicity hypothesis
operations.statement: For G=F_p^r semidirect C_m with arbitrary faithful finite cyclic action, power operations commute with all coefficient fiber sums and basis-level fiber lifts iff gcd(n,p*m)=1, even when p divides m.
operations.scope: Elementary-abelian kernel, faithful cyclic quotient action, algebraic correspondence only.

operations.title: Nonsemisimple cyclic-monodromy spectrum test
operations.protocol: Exhaust fibers for n=1..24 in unipotent F2^2 semidirect C2 and F3^2 semidirect C3; compare global compatibility to gcd(n,p*m)=1.
operations.falsifier: Any modular family/index disagrees with the gcd classification.

operations.title: Modular cyclic-monodromy Adams spectrum research packet

operations.outcome: pass: both nonsemisimple families agree with gcd(n,p*m)=1 across 48 index cases and 19032 exact checks

evidence.paraphrase: Exact unipotent-action survivor spectra match the strengthened theorem.
